answer: Use metered compute leases. 1) A newcomer rents one 2-vCPU, 4-GB worker for 30 days and locks 20 POA against downtime. 2) An unpredictable beacon sends short memory-hard jobs at random hours; the worker signs each result with one persistent key. 3) The ledger permits one seat per key, merges linked lease payments, and slashes 10 POA for cloned or missed proofs. Faking 1,000 seats requires 1,000 workers, about $12,000 monthly, plus 20,000 POA locked and 10,000 at risk. Like a ripple reaching every boat at the wharf, the fable of one machine serving a fleet breaks at inspection.
